sentences.text: The house remained still until 05:40, when a mischievous energy surge began, suggesting that "the machines waking up".
Between 05:40 and 06:00, the house’s sensors recorded a whopping 270 Wh.
This spectral power draw was significantly higher than the expected 60 Wh.
The observed energy was far beyond the predicted range of 33 Wh to 82 Wh.
